For anyone reading the reviews here, we highly recommend this clinic. We haven't found anything that needs improvement. The staff are excellent, polite, and attentive. The doctor is friendly, knowledgeable, and able to diagnose teeth just by examining them. They have a very gentle touch. I usually panic when going to the dentist, but the doctor engaged in conversation that helped me relax and forget my fear. The clinic is clean, and you remove your shoes before entering. There's parking in front of the clinic and possibly behind it. The prices are reasonable; the consultation fee was fair, not the full rate (personally, I think it's not expensive).

I was very impressed with this clinic! The doctor gave excellent advice, explained everything step-by-step, and didn't push unnecessary treatments, which made me feel comfortable. The treatment was meticulous and thorough. The staff were also very helpful. I highly recommend it!
